prompt:
Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Alien civilization world, grey-purple ruins, ochre sand, stone cairns. Sky state strictly follow scene. Never use modern laboratory. 
SCENE: 삼체 게임 내부. 폐허. EP003의 세 태양은 사라지고, 하늘은 불길한 잿빛-보라색. 그림자가 없는 확산광. 구조물 잔해 — 거대한 뼈 같은 것, 녹아내린 금속, 결정화된 유리. 한가운데 왕먀오가 혼자 서 있다.
Visible named cast: 왕먀오. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
